confidence.ridge_h_m: low-medium: the lantern top = deck + lantern height, 13.3 + 3.2

confidence.low_walls: medium: the left row from the render match to photos 004/009 (2 bays); the right row is open everywhere (003, 005, 006, 009, 027) and has no wall

notes: 2026-10-02 hall corrections, each with its source: (1) the LEFT low wall is 2 closed bays, not 5 (the 09-28 features file said bays 3-7 from photo 032, wrong): from_door_m [24, 36]. (2) the RIGHT low wall (a GUESS in the 09-28 file, [60, 84]) is deleted: the right row is open (003, 005, 006, 009, 027: machinery and pipes between the columns). (3) the crane cab hangs at the RIGHT (+x) end (002, 003, 004, 005, 009, 013), x 8.35-10.35 in the nave crane's frame. (4) the roof underside 11.0 -> 10.8 m (Soviet height series 8.4 / 9.6 / 10.8 / 12.0) and the top chord 13.5 -> 13.3 (2.5 m depth kept). (5) the lantern 3.5 -> 3.2 m (standard lantern for a 24 m span: 2.77 or 3.22 m). (6) the right runway girder has no handrail; the left one keeps it.

Left unchanged on purpose: the crane rail (7.6 m in this layer set; the standards give 7.75 for 16-20 t or 8.15 for <= 10 t cranes and the crane's capacity is unknown, so measure on site); the 6 x 6 x 2.5 m space frame (photo-derived; it is NOT the 'Kislovodsk' series, which is 3 x 3 x 2.12 m for low buildings); the expansion joint (the lantern gap is the evidence); the floor-rail gauge (unmeasured).

2026-10-02, permanent objects near the stage (emily-41, from a researcher's pass over all 36 photos; the transformer (021) and the press pedestal (024) checked by hand): the 11 massing_add items are the things that stay when the hall is cleared (transformer, column-foot cabinets, press pedestal, press-side cabinets, blower, lean-to canopy, drum tank, prefab cabin, right-row pipe rack). Ignored on purpose, being loose and due to be cleared: the five 5-6 m pressure vessels at x -6..0, z -2..+8, gas cylinders, scrap, bags, boards. Corrected: the far crane at 76.2 m from the door (was 95.0); the floor rails are one track at x about 0 in the entry zone (z 20 to the door) plus two transverse lines at z 38 and 46, all LOW confidence. HELD for the originals or a site check: the machine line's length (it may run on to z 10-14), the transformer's exact z, and whether the pedestal and cabinets are bolted.
